description_en: Creates a database schema import task. This operation imports SQL script files or text content that contains DDL statements into a target database instance and automatically executes structured operations such as creating tables, indexes, views, and stored procedures
description_zh: 用于创建数据库结构导入任务，支持将包含 DDL语句的 SQL 脚本文件或文本内容导入到目标数据库实例中，自动执行建表、创建索引、视图、存储过程等结构化操作
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-structure-import-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --slink-task-id etx-szr2rr6i00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateStructureImportTask

parameters.help_en: The region in which the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target task. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the execution status of the target task, including the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标任务id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标任务的执行状态，包括任务id
parameters.name: slink_task_id

Message.description_en: The returned message. > This parameter is empty if the request is successful. If the request fails, an exception message is returned, such as an error code
Message.description_zh: 返回消息。>请求成功时该参数为空，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
